v4_truth_ledger.current_truth: V4.0.0 is a bounded operator release with 8 measured generic Tier-2 surfaces.
Torch CUDA is the main measured V4 device-array partner.
CuPy has strong historical V2/V3 route evidence but no V4-certified performance surface.
Fixed Numba continuation evidence exists; arbitrary Numba callback remains Tier-3 spike-only.
No complete app-level V4 vs V2.14/V3 benchmark has passed.
